Camber Capital Management Maintains Position in Clovis Oncology (CLVS); As Facebook (FB) Market Valuation Declined, Holder Boothbay Fund Management Has Cut Holding
May 27, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Stephen Dubois increased its stake in Clovis Oncology Inc (CLVS) by 200% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Camber Capital Management Llc bought 400,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 18.56% with the market. The hedge fund run by Stephen Dubois held 600,000 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $40.80M, up from 200,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Camber Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Clovis Oncology Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.56B market cap company. The stock increased 2.34% or $1.11 during the last trading session, reaching $48.63. About 468,861 shares traded. Clovis Oncology, Inc. (NASDAQ:CLVS) has declined 21.43% since May 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 32.98% the S&P500.
Boothbay Fund Management Llc decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 15.98% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
